purpose: Remove the observed offline-device execution blocker for the unchanged receiver AST and eleven synthetic metadata/path controls. This is evidence-handler testing, not a product or scale measurement.
intended_parent: The R20 evidence checkpoint, after root supplies cutoff and publishes it; no parent commit or execution ID has been guessed.

github_execution.actual_identity: First actual GITHUB_SHA, checkout HEAD, push event, exact branch, run ID and attempt must agree. IDs remain unknown before root publishes.
github_execution.subprocess: Runner-resolved Linux sys.executable -B consumer/test_contract.py --controller <fixed consumer.py> --operator <fixed operator.py> --output <fresh owned controls-report.json>
github_execution.output_directory: RUNNER_TEMP/p8-original-receiver-controls-<actual run ID>; fresh mkdir, existing path refuses; only a successful owned mkdir sets created=True and permits final evidence writes
github_execution.source_binding: Registered three full Git blob IDs + UTF8 bytes + SHA256; three source files, wrapper, plan and workflow match actual HEAD bytes before and after. Checkout credentials are not persisted and no token is passed to the synthetic subprocess.

acceptance.original_suite: Run unchanged 161db232dce15211761551861a7a13248801c2b0 once. It parses/compiles both fixed modules and calls only register, selected_entries_unchanged and canonical_matrix with fabricated data.
acceptance.exact_per_method: Actual original report methods and eleven verbose '... ok' lines must equal the listed ordered IDs.
acceptance.module_results: Original report requires both pinned modules' AST_and_compile=passed, executed_as_operation=false; receiver_executed=false and operator_executed=false.
acceptance.failures: Original nonzero exit, incomplete report, source mismatch, changed bytes, missing or extra methods, ignore, timeout or output bound failure rejects. Original stdout/stderr and any report remain in always-upload evidence.
acceptance.after_success: Only AST plus eleven synthetic controls become executed; no full150 source/raw acceptance or task completion follows automatically.

transport.byte_contract: Frames encode each original file's raw bytes, never a reserialized parsed JSON object. A header gives name/bytes/SHA256/count; ordered zero-based chunks give index/count/bytes/SHA256/base64; an end repeats the complete bytes/SHA256/count.
transport.decoder: After stripping only the Actions timestamp prefix, parse exact schema/name. Require exactly one header and end per expected present name; receive every zero-based index once and in order; strict base64 decode; verify each raw chunk size/hash, final count/bytes/hash and header=end; then parse the recovered original JSON bytes. Keep all failure stdout/stderr bytes. Reject duplicate/missing/out-of-order/corrupted chunks. Empty files have count0 and SHA256(empty).
transport.secrets: No private artifact URL or token is requested or emitted. Subprocess receives only four explicit benign environment variables. Wrapper error output is type plus basename/function/line, without exception values/argv. Full logs are from fixed synthetic code only.

author_pre_execution_validation.scope: Author source inspection only; fixed drafts require nonauthor review then a first actual hosted run. No new control pass is claimed.

preserved_pre_execution_drafts.blocker: v1 finally could write a pre-existing output directory after fresh-path rejection. No v1 workflow was published or executed.
preserved_pre_execution_drafts.fix: Only successful new-directory creation enables finally evidence access; exact three runner substitutions plus two workflow pin substitutions.
